test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The solution is **Intermenable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The INCORRECTLY spelt word is Intermenable.
 
• The correct spelt word is Interminable.
 
• Interminable - endless.
 
 
• ​For example : We had an interminable talk.
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information on other options:
 
 
• **Intubate - **Insert a tube into (a person or a body part.)
 
• **Incredible - **Impossible to believe.
 
• **Incredulous - **(of a person or their manner) unwilling or unable to believe something.
